strings.zh: 奇怪？听不大清楚⋯⋯{NEWLINE}难道是电话⋯⋯坏了吗？{SCROLL}你换个地方再打过来吧！
strings.en: Huh? I can’t hear you very well.{NEWLINE}I wonder if it’s our connection?{SCROLL}Try calling again from somewhere else.

strings.zh: 喂喂⋯⋯{NEWLINE}你最近怎么样？{CLEAR}我还是老样子啊。{CLEAR}每天待在道馆里等训练家来挑战,{CLEAR}实话实说真的有点无聊{SCROLL}
strings.en: Hello...{NEWLINE}How have you been?{SCROLL}I am the same as ever. Every day{NEWLINE}I wait in my Gym for challengers.{SCROLL}To be honest, it is a little dull.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 除了道馆馆主以外,{NEWLINE}还有在馆主之上的四天王,{CLEAR}要成为最强训练家,{CLEAR}需要翻越的大山可真多呀！
strings.en: Above the Gym Leaders stand the Elite{NEWLINE}Four. To become the strongest Trainer,{CLEAR}you have many mountains yet to climb.

strings.zh: 星期天的白天{NEWLINE}我一般都是有时间的。{SCROLL}到时候你能{NEWLINE}打个电话过来吗⋯⋯？
strings.en: I am usually free on Sundays around{NEWLINE}noon. Could you give me a call then...?
strings.notes: US 0655/4 | RV071: voice: 'usually', Sabrina's formal register (noon kept, see D-1913)

strings.zh: 啊,太好了！{NEWLINE}现在正好闲得没事呢。{SCROLL}再来和我比一场吧？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Ah, wonderful!{NEWLINE}I’ve got some free time right now.{SCROLL}Would you like to battle again? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 我就说嘛,{NEWLINE}你肯定会答应的⋯⋯{SCROLL}那么我在战斗前线的{NEWLINE}训练家屋等你！
strings.en: I knew it. I knew you would accept...{SCROLL}Then I will be waiting for you at the{NEWLINE}Trainer House at the Battle Frontier!
strings.notes: US 0655/6 | Rematch venue: the hack changed the US Fighting Dojo in Saffron City to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.

strings.zh: 是吗⋯⋯{NEWLINE}虽然我也预感到{CLEAR}可能会被拒绝⋯⋯{CLEAR}好可惜⋯⋯
strings.en: I see...{NEWLINE}I did foresee that you might{CLEAR}refuse... What a pity...

strings.zh: 你现在怎么会有空{NEWLINE}和我战斗呢？{SCROLL}你还有其他预约的话,{NEWLINE}请先去解决掉吧。
strings.en: How is it that you have time to{NEWLINE}battle me now? If you have other{CLEAR}appointments, please take care of{CLEAR}them first.
strings.notes: US 0655/8 | RV071: meaning: closer to zh question and request

strings.zh: 我在战斗前线的{NEWLINE}训练家屋等你。{CLEAR}不要忘了。
strings.en: I will be waiting for you at the{NEWLINE}Trainer House at the Battle{CLEAR}Frontier. Do not forget.
strings.notes: Rematch venue: the hack changed the US Fighting Dojo in Saffron City to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.

strings.zh: 我们不是约好了在战斗前线的{NEWLINE}训练家屋对战吗⋯⋯{CLEAR}难道你忘了？
strings.en: Did we not agree to battle at{NEWLINE}the Trainer House at the Battle{CLEAR}Frontier...? Have you forgotten?
strings.notes: US 0655/11 | Rematch venue: the hack changed the US Fighting Dojo in Saffron City to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.

strings.zh: 我告诉你一些关于{NEWLINE}训练超能力的技巧吧{SCROLL}所谓超能力{NEWLINE}就是能操纵心灵的能力,{SCROLL}闭上双眼,将你心中的{NEWLINE}杂念抹去⋯⋯{CLEAR}重新审视长眠在{CLEAR}你心中的自我⋯⋯{SCROLL}就是这样,{SCROLL}真正的超能力{NEWLINE}并非使用超能力{CLEAR}移动物品什么的,{SCROLL}而是正确地{NEWLINE}掌控自己的心灵。
strings.en: Let me share a little{NEWLINE}about psychic training.{SCROLL}Psychic power is the{NEWLINE}power to govern the mind.{SCROLL}Close your eyes and wipe away{NEWLINE}the idle thoughts in your{CLEAR}heart... Then look anew at the{CLEAR}self that sleeps within you...{SCROLL}That is all.{SCROLL}True psychic power is not{NEWLINE}moving objects with your mind.{SCROLL}It is mastering your own mind.

strings.zh: 我看到了,{NEWLINE}你今后{CLEAR}还会变得更强⋯⋯{SCROLL}在和所有的训练家的战斗中{NEWLINE}获得最终的胜利,{CLEAR}我看到了那个{CLEAR}得到了无上光荣的你⋯⋯{SCROLL}今天就说到这,{NEWLINE}再见！
strings.en: I see it... You will grow stronger{NEWLINE}still...{SCROLL}Victorious in the end over every Trainer{NEWLINE}you face, crowned in the highest{CLEAR}glory... That is how I see you...{SCROLL}That is all for today. Farewell!

strings.zh: 我认为你是一个{NEWLINE}智慧、力量、心智,{CLEAR}都非常平衡的训练家。{SCROLL}我还能感受到{NEWLINE}你心智中特别的东西⋯⋯{SCROLL}去进行一次{NEWLINE}真正的超能力修行{CLEAR}怎么样？{SCROLL}或许你能成为一名{NEWLINE}超越我的超能力者⋯⋯
strings.en: I believe you are a Trainer with a fine{NEWLINE}balance of wisdom, strength and spirit.{SCROLL}And I sense something{NEWLINE}special in your mind...{SCROLL}Why not try some true psychic training?{SCROLL}Perhaps you could become a{NEWLINE}psychic who surpasses even me...
